basic_details.job_title: Delhi University South Campus Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Genetics, University of Delhi South Campus, New Delhi, has invited applications for two Project Research Scientist-I posts (Rs. 56,000 plus HRA per month) and two Project Technical Support-III posts (Rs. 28,000 plus HRA per month) in the ICMR Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) project "To establish shodhvik oncology liquid biopsy hotspot assay platform". The appointment is temporary and the project is funded until 31.08.2029. Applications are made on plain paper by post to the Principal Investigator, and must reach the address within 15 days of appearance of the advertisement

how_to_apply: Write the application on plain paper with detailed bio-data.
Enclose copies of the relevant certificates.

Address it to: Principal Investigator, Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) ICMR Project, Room no. 303, Genetics Department, 2nd Floor, Biotech Building, University of Delhi, South Campus, New Delhi - 110021.
Make sure it reaches that address within 15 days of appearance of the advertisement.
The notice does not name a mode of sending (post, courier or by hand) and prints no email address.
Application on plain paper with detailed bio-data
important_instructions: The appointment is on temporary basis and linked to the project, which is funded until 31.08.2029. Pay is as sanctioned in the project. For Project Research Scientist-I, only candidates with a publication in a peer review journal will be considered. SC/ST reservations apply as per university and ICMR rules.

content_sections.heading: About DU Genetics ICMR Project
content_sections.text: The Department of Genetics is part of the University of Delhi South Campus, New Delhi. The posts are in the Centre for Advance Research (CAR) ICMR project "To establish shodhvik oncology liquid biopsy hotspot assay platform". The notice signs off with the Principal Investigator of the Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) ICMR Project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 4 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

rows.pay: Rs. 56000/- plus HRA per month as sanctioned in the project
Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA per month as sanctioned in the project

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for both posts is 35 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. SC/ST reservations for the posts apply as per university and ICMR rules. The notice states that candidates with a publication in a peer review journal will be only considered. The notice states the qualification as three years graduate in relevant subject/field plus three years government experience, or PG in relevant subject/field of Cancer Genomics. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: First class post-graduation degree, including the integrated PG degree; OR second class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with Ph.D.; OR Engineering/IT/CS first class graduate degree of four years
rows.desirable: 3 years of experience in a government institute academic research lab

rows.essential_qualification: Three years graduate in relevant subject/field plus three years government experience; OR PG in relevant subject/field of Cancer Genomics

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments are paid as sanctioned in the project. Project Research Scientist-I gets Rs. 56000/- plus HRA per month. Project Technical Support-III gets Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA per month. The appointment is on temporary basis, and the project is funded until 31.08.2029.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are vacant in the DU Genetics ICMR project?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 Project Research Scientist-I and 2 Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the address within 15 days of appearance of the advertisement. The notice prints no calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: A first class post-graduation degree including the integrated PG degree, or a second class post graduate degree including the integrated PG degrees with Ph.D., or a first class Engineering/IT/CS graduate degree of four years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Three years graduate in relevant subject/field plus three years government experience, or PG in relevant subject/field of Cancer Genomics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist-I gets Rs. 56000/- plus HRA per month, and Project Technical Support-III gets Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA per month, as sanctioned in the project.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with detailed bio-data and copies of relevant certificates to the Principal Investigator, Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) ICMR Project, Room no. 303, Genetics Department, 2nd Floor, Biotech Building, University of Delhi South Campus, New Delhi - 110021.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on temporary basis, and the project is funded until 31.08.2029.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as Rs. 56000/- and Rs. 28,000/- "plus HRA per month as sanctioned in the project".

faq.question: Q10. Do SC/ST reservations apply?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST reservations for the posts apply as per university and ICMR rules.
